model.name: N5 HOA speech EDM prior
model.architecture: Independent NCSN++M-derived time-frequency U-Net with adaptive layer normalization and EDM preconditioning

sources.title: HARP
sources.license: No repository license found; upstream code is not redistributed

data.scene_split_policy: Speaker-disjoint VCTK training/validation/test; no WSJ0. Scene seeds are distinct across all splits.

configuration.normalization: One common complex RMS per clean training example; H(z)=3|z|^0.67 exp(i phase); divide by fixed uncentered compressed RMS from the first 16 training examples. Inference uses Linear-estimate RMS for the first scale, never reference RMS. The compressed_std key stores RMS without mean subtraction.
configuration.sigma_sampling: Continuous uniform interpolation parameter on the Eq.11 rho curve; the paper does not disclose training M.
configuration.compressed_scale_statistic: sqrt(mean(x_real_imag**2)), pooled over the first 16 training examples; no mean subtraction
configuration.complex_noise_convention: Independent real and imaginary Gaussian noise with standard deviation sigma each; expected squared complex noise magnitude is 2*sigma**2.

evaluation.split: speaker- and scene-disjoint VCTK test subset
evaluation.metric: 10 log10 pooled squared error / pooled clean energy, in compressed 72-real-channel STFT coordinates, before inverse encoding.
evaluation.summary: Trained beats noisy identity at 9/10 noise levels; beats the isotropic Gaussian prior at 8/10. This is denoising, not the paper's Linear-versus-ADEPS encoding benchmark.

matched: Ideal order-5, 36 complex Ambisonics channels as the training target
No acquisition-array geometry, aliasing or microphone noise in training
Reverberant speech targets from VCTK and HARP-derived ideal HOA room simulation
EDM preconditioning, weighted denoising loss, sigma range 0.002–80 and rho=10
Time-frequency convolutional denoiser with noise-conditioned adaptive layer normalization
differences: Independent network implementation; official ADEPS weights and full training code were not available at verification.
Exact topology, optimizer, STFT and signal normalization are independently specified because they are not fully disclosed.
VCTK subset and limited actual optimizer steps; a 20,000-scene pool is not 20,000 completed training examples.
Held-out VCTK speakers replace licensed WSJ0 evaluation; this is not the paper benchmark.
No claim of paper-level quality, convergence, room calibration or measured real-array generalization.

documentation_notes: The training source used the label compressed standard deviation for an uncentered RMS. This descriptive label was corrected after code audit; the stored scalar, weights, losses and evaluation scores are unchanged.
examples_seen and unique_scenes_seen count optimizer inputs. The separate first-16 training examples used for fixed RMS estimation are not added to these optimizer counts.
Same-checkpoint reconstruction examples are fixed in advance and include regressions. They do not establish paper-quality reproduction.
The resume command requires the locally retained training-state.pt optimizer/RNG snapshot; inference weights alone cannot resume training.
